base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_058",
       STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS age,
       T1."XCL_059" AS sex
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L."XCL_014" = T1."XCL_058" AND L."XCL_019" >= 48
  ) >= 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L."XCL_014" = T1."XCL_058" AND L."XCL_018" >= 160
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L."XCL_014" = T1."XCL_058" AND L."XCL_026" < 250
  )

JOIN Laboratory l2 ON p.XCL_058 = l2.XCL_014
JOIN Laboratory l3 ON p.XCL_058 = l3.XCL_014
WHERE p.XCL_063 = 'M'
  AND l1.XCL_020 >= 48
  AND l2.XCL_021 >= 160
  AND l3.XCL_022 < 250

    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM Laboratory l4
    WHERE l4.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
      AND l4.XCL_020 >= 48
  ) >= 2
